name: credential-expert
description: Local credential storage for AI coding agents — index file plus OS keystore (macOS Keychain) for tokens used by other plugins

interface.shortDescription: Local credential storage for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Skill for storing and reading API tokens used by other plugins. A non-secret index file at ~/.agents/credentials.json (mode 0600) maps credential names to OS-keystore references; the actual secrets live in macOS Keychain as per-credential generic-password items. Documents the schema, the security CLI commands for set/read/delete/rotate, the safe consumption pattern for other skills, a pre-commit hook for accidental-commit defense, and the threat model.
